en.headline: You start the work. Bot carries it forward.
en.request: Two hours at my desk already. Fix login and review the release checklist in parallel.
en.ack: I’ll start two Workers: one to fix login and add tests, another to review the release checklist. I’ll bring the results back here.
taskPrompts: Fix the login redirect and add regression tests.
Review the release checklist and flag open questions.
en.complete: Login is fixed and all three regression tests pass. The release checklist is ready, with one item for you to confirm.
en.notice: You’ve been working for two hours. This is a good stopping point. Take a moment to stretch?
en.feedback: Good idea. Next time, wait until my current task is finished before reminding me.
en.remember: Got it. I’ll wait for a natural break in your work before nudging you again.

scenes.title: Start a conversation
scenes.summary: Type a request in Caelis Bot. It replies and starts two background Workers.

scenes.title: Follow the work
scenes.summary: Hover a task bubble and open its Codex terminal. Results return to the same Bot conversation.

scenes.title: Bot reaches out
scenes.summary: Bot notices a long work session in the conversation, creates a callback for a natural break, then reaches out. Your reply shapes the next reminder.

en.clue: Two hours at my desk already.
en.observation: A long work session, with two tasks still underway.
en.callback: When these tasks finish, check the latest context and offer a break at a good moment.

zh-cn.headline: 你发起一件事，或者让它先开口。
zh-cn.request: 已经连着忙了两个小时。帮我修复登录跳转，再核对发布清单，两个任务分别推进。
zh-cn.ack: 好，我启动两个 Worker：一个修复登录并补测试，一个核对发布清单。有结果会回到这里告诉你。
taskPrompts: 修复登录跳转，并补上回归测试。
核对发布清单，标出仍需确认的问题。
zh-cn.complete: 登录跳转已修复，3 个回归测试全部通过。发布清单也整理好了，还有一项需要你确认。
zh-cn.notice: 已经连续忙了两个小时。刚好告一段落，要不要起来活动一下？
zh-cn.feedback: 好，我先休息一下。下次等手头任务结束再提醒我。
zh-cn.remember: 好，记住了。以后等任务告一段落，再轻轻提醒你。

scenes.title: 交代任务
scenes.summary: 在聊天框中输入请求，Bot 回复并启动两个后台 Worker。

scenes.title: 查看 Worker
scenes.summary: 悬停任务气泡，点击打开对应的 Codex 终端。完成后，结果回到同一段对话。

scenes.title: Bot 主动开口
scenes.summary: Bot 从对话中发现持续工作的线索，自行安排回调，等任务结束后主动关心；再根据你的回复调整下一次提醒。

zh-cn.clue: 已经连着忙了两个小时。
zh-cn.observation: 已经连续工作，手头还有两个任务在推进。
zh-cn.callback: 等当前任务结束，再结合最新上下文，找合适的时机提醒休息。
